chunks: Rifāʿah ibn Mūsā asked Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:
about a man who touched his female servant during the Month of Ramadan and emitted madhy.
He عليه السلام said: “If it was unlawful, then he must seek Allah’s forgiveness with the seeking forgiveness of one who will never return to it ever, and he must fast one day in place of one day.”

key_terms.حَرَامًا: unlawful in the sacred legal sense
key_terms.شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ: the Month of Ramadan, during which fasting is obligatory
key_terms.فَلْيَسْتَغْفِرِ اللَّهَ: then he must seek Allah’s forgiveness
key_terms.لَامَسَ: touched in an intimate physical manner
key_terms.يَصُومُ يَوْمًا مَكَانَ يَوْمٍ: he must fast one day in place of that day

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if someone touches his female servant in Ramadan and emits madhy?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding intimate contact during Ramadan that leads to the emission of madhy. If the act was haram, the person must sincerely seek Allah’s forgiveness with true resolve not to repeat it and make up one day of fasting.
